data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the right order (Booking search, xe.com EUR conversion, mail draft, discard) and gets most parameters right, but it leaves out the traveler parameter, which sets the recipient address and the greeting, and the review-score ≥8 selection rule. It also lists "hotel" as a parameter even though that value is discovered during the run, and it never says the Reserve and Send buttons must not be clicked. Because of those gaps, an automation built from the spec alone would have to guess at several details.
